title: Venir, tenir et prendre : trois familles utiles
summary: Use `venir`, `tenir` and `prendre` with all their present stems and transfer the patterns to common derivatives.

sections.title: Singular `-ien-`, `nous/vous` `-en-`, and plural `-ienn-`
paragraphs: `Venir` means come; `tenir` means hold or keep. They share the same stem alternation: `viens/venons/viennent` and `tiens/tenons/tiennent`. The `il/elle/on` form ends in `-t`, while `je` and `tu` end in `-s`. Derivatives keep the pattern after their prefix: `revenir` (come back), `devenir` (become), `retenir` (retain/remember or hold back) and `obtenir` (obtain).

For a derivative, keep its prefix before every form: `revenir` gives `reviens`, `reviens`, `revient`, `revenons`, `revenez`, `reviennent`; `retenir` gives `retiens`, `retiens`, `retient`, `retenons`, `retenez`, `retiennent`. These lists follow `je`, `tu`, `il/elle/on`, `nous`, `vous`, `ils/elles` order.
points: Do not extend the singular stem unchanged to `nous` or `vous`.

examples.note: `Retenir` can mean retain in memory; `un numéro` (m.) is a number.

sections.title: `Prendre` loses `d` in the plural and doubles `n` only with `ils/elles`
paragraphs: `Prendre` means take; it also appears when choosing food or transport. Unlike regular `vendre`, it loses `d` in all plural present forms and doubles `n` with `ils/elles`. `Apprendre` (learn), `comprendre` (understand), `reprendre` (take again/resume) and `surprendre` (surprise) follow it.

The complete derivative patterns are `j'apprends`, `tu apprends`, `il/elle/on apprend`, `nous apprenons`, `vous apprenez`, `ils/elles apprennent`; `je comprends`, `tu comprends`, `il/elle/on comprend`, `nous comprenons`, `vous comprenez`, `ils/elles comprennent`.
points: Compare `nous vendons` with `nous prenons`: not all `-dre` verbs are regular.

`Une consigne` (f.) is an instruction; `comprendre` uses `nn` with `ils/elles`.

production_task.prompt: Write a note about a class visit: say when you are coming, what transport the group takes and what you are learning.
production_task.model_answer: Je viens demain. Nous prenons le métro. Nous apprenons le français ensemble.
production_task.translation: I am coming tomorrow. We take the metro. We are learning French together.
